title: Solid-State Battery Market Outlook 2026
text: The global solid-state battery market reached $1.9 billion in revenue in 2025, according to Helix Research. The firm projects the market will grow to $8.4 billion by 2030, a compound annual growth rate of 34.6%. Automotive applications account for 62% of demand, followed by consumer electronics at 21% and grid storage at 9%. Asia-Pacific holds 48% of installed manufacturing capacity, Europe 31% and North America 17%. Analysts expect the first mass-market electric vehicles with solid-state packs to ship in late 2027.

title: Quantor Cells opens 12 GWh solid-state plant in Leipzig
text: Quantor Cells opened a 12 GWh solid-state battery plant in Leipzig, Germany, in March 2026. The company uses a sulfide electrolyte and has a supply agreement with Ardent Motors for its 2027 sedan. Quantor Cells is the market leader with an estimated 27% share of 2025 solid-state battery revenue. Its two main rivals are Lumisolid, which uses an oxide electrolyte, and Hesper Energy, which uses a polymer electrolyte.

title: Why solid-state batteries are still hard to build
text: Three problems slow solid-state batteries down. First, lithium dendrites can still grow through the electrolyte under fast charging. Second, cost: solid-state cells cost about $210 per kWh in 2025, compared with $115 per kWh for lithium-ion packs. Third, manufacturing yield: average production yield across the industry was 71% in 2025, against more than 95% for mature lithium-ion lines. Lumisolid says its oxide process reached an 80% yield in pilot production.

title: Lithium-ion pack prices keep falling
text: Average lithium-ion battery pack prices fell to $115 per kWh in 2025, down 14% from the year before, driven by cheaper cathode materials and overcapacity in cell manufacturing. Lower prices for conventional packs make it harder for new chemistries to compete on cost.

title: RISC-V edge AI chip market report 2026
text: The market for RISC-V based edge AI chips reached $3.1 billion in 2025, with 2.4 billion RISC-V cores shipped in edge devices. Chipinsight forecasts $9.7 billion by 2029. Industrial IoT is the largest segment at 37% of revenue, followed by smart cameras at 24% and wearables at 15%. Licensing cost is the main reason vendors give for choosing RISC-V over proprietary instruction sets.

title: Veltrix Semiconductors launches V9 edge NPU
text: Veltrix Semiconductors announced the V9, a RISC-V edge AI processor delivering 18 TOPS at 2.1 watts. Samples ship to customers in Q2 2026. Veltrix holds 41% of RISC-V edge AI design wins, ahead of Corvana at 22% and Openfab Systems at 13%.

title: EU commits funding to open instruction-set chips
text: The European Union committed EUR 270 million to open instruction-set chip design between 2026 and 2028. Corvana, based in Eindhoven, received the largest single grant of EUR 45 million to develop automotive-grade RISC-V processors.

title: Proprietary core royalties rise
text: Royalty rates for leading proprietary CPU cores rose by an average of 18% in 2025. Several microcontroller vendors said the increase pushed them to evaluate open alternatives.

title: Vertical farming market 2026: growth after the shake-out
text: The vertical farming market was worth $6.3 billion in 2025 and is expected to reach $11.8 billion by 2030. Two large operators went bankrupt in 2024, which analysts blame on energy costs. Energy is now 38% of a typical vertical farm's operating cost. Leafy greens make up 71% of production.

title: Canopy Grid raises $140 million
text: Canopy Grid raised $140 million in a Series C round to build a 9-hectare vertical farm near Rotterdam, which it says will be the largest in Europe. Its main competitor, Tierra Vertical, operates 14 smaller farms across Spain and Portugal.

title: LED efficiency and the economics of vertical farms
text: Horticultural LEDs reached an efficacy of 3.4 micromoles per joule in 2025. Even so, lettuce from vertical farms costs about $3.90 per kg to produce, against $1.60 per kg for field-grown lettuce. Lower electricity prices and higher automation are the two biggest levers to close the gap.

title: Top 10 gadgets of 2026
text: Our favourite gadgets this year include a foldable e-reader, a solar phone charger and smart glasses.

title: Aster Analytics: solid-state battery market estimate
text: Aster Analytics estimates the solid-state battery market at $2.6 billion in 2025, higher than other published figures because it includes pilot-line sample sales. Aster expects $7.9 billion by 2030.

title: Green hydrogen electrolyzer market 2026
text: Electrolyzer shipments reached 4.1 GW in 2025, worth $5.2 billion. The market is forecast to reach $14.5 billion by 2030. Alkaline electrolyzers hold 58% of shipments and PEM electrolyzers 36%. China accounts for 61% of manufacturing capacity.

title: Voltagen opens PEM electrolyzer gigafactory
text: Voltagen opened a 2 GW PEM electrolyzer factory in Rotterdam in February 2026. Voltagen is the largest PEM supplier outside China with a 19% share of global PEM shipments. Its main competitors are Electra Hydro, which makes alkaline systems, and Nordlys Systems, which develops solid-oxide electrolyzers.

title: Why green hydrogen is still expensive
text: Green hydrogen cost about $5.10 per kg to produce in 2025, against $1.80 per kg for hydrogen made from natural gas. Electricity is roughly 70% of the cost. Stack degradation and low utilisation of electrolyzers running on intermittent renewables are the main technical problems.

title: Satellite broadband market report 2026
text: The satellite broadband market had 9.3 million subscribers at the end of 2025 and revenue of $11.4 billion. Orbitlink leads with 68% of subscribers, followed by Skyweave at 14%. Revenue is forecast to reach $24 billion by 2030. Maritime and aviation connectivity are the fastest growing segments.

title: Skyweave completes first constellation shell
text: Skyweave completed its first shell of 648 satellites in January 2026 and plans 1,920 satellites in total. The company charges $79 per month for its standard plan, compared with $99 for Orbitlink's equivalent plan.

title: Spectrum and debris rules tighten for satellite operators
text: Regulators now require low-earth-orbit satellites to deorbit within 5 years of mission end, down from 25 years. Spectrum coordination disputes delayed 3 constellation launches in 2025. Launch costs remain the largest capital expense for new operators.

title: Plant-based meat market 2026: a slowdown
text: Global plant-based meat sales were $6.9 billion in 2025, down 4% from 2024 after three years of growth. Retail volumes fell 7% in the United States but grew 9% in Asia. Verdant Foods is the largest brand with 22% of global sales.

title: Proteus bets on fermentation protein
text: Proteus, the second largest plant-based brand with 15% of global sales, will move 40% of its production to precision-fermentation protein by 2027. The company says fermentation lowers ingredient costs by about 30% compared with pea protein.

title: The price gap holding plant-based meat back
text: Plant-based burgers cost on average 43% more per kg than beef burgers in 2025. Taste and texture are the most common reasons shoppers give for not buying again, followed by price.

title: eVTOL air taxi market outlook
text: No eVTOL air taxi service was in commercial operation at the end of 2025. Analysts at Skyline Research forecast the market at $1.2 billion in 2028 and $9.8 billion by 2033. Order books across all manufacturers total 7,400 aircraft.

title: AeroVolt nears type certification
text: AeroVolt completed 85% of its type-certification test flights by March 2026 and expects certification in early 2027. AeroVolt holds 2,100 aircraft orders, the largest order book in the sector, ahead of Skylane with 1,350.

title: Batteries and noise: the limits on air taxis
text: Current battery packs give air taxis a practical range of about 100 km with reserves. Noise limits in city centres and the lack of vertiports are the other main barriers named by operators.

title: MarketPulse: eVTOL market sizing
text: MarketPulse projects the eVTOL air taxi market at $3.5 billion in 2028, nearly three times other forecasts, because it counts cargo drones and pilot training alongside passenger services.

title: Post-quantum cryptography market 2026
text: Spending on post-quantum cryptography products reached $820 million in 2025 and is forecast to reach $4.3 billion by 2030. Banks account for 34% of spending and government agencies for 29%. Latticeguard is the market leader with a 26% share.

title: Q-Shield ships quantum-safe hardware security modules
text: Q-Shield began shipping hardware security modules with post-quantum key exchange in November 2025. Q-Shield holds 18% of the post-quantum cryptography market, second to Latticeguard.

title: Why post-quantum migration is slow
text: A survey of 400 large organisations found that only 12% had a complete inventory of the cryptography they use. Larger key sizes and legacy hardware that cannot be updated are the main migration problems.
